raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On Intel XPU, EAGLE-family speculative decoding (EAGLE / EAGLE3 / NEXTN, i.e. MTP) has two problems:

- **Most NextN/MTP drafts crash at startup.** `set_embed_and_head` / `set_embed` call `torch.cuda.synchronize()`, which raises `Torch not compiled with CUDA enabled` on torch+xpu. Affected: DeepSeek-V3/R1, GLM-4.x/5, Qwen3-Next, MiMo-V2, Nemotron-H, LongCat, Kimi-K2.5 EAGLE3 and others.
- **Sampling is silently dropped.** XPU verify is always greedy, with no warning, and `--speculative-use-rejection-sampling` is accepted but does nothing.

## Modifications

- **models:** use `current_platform.empty_cache()` / `synchronize()` in `set_embed_and_head` / `set_embed`. This is mechanical: 75 sites in 33 files. CUDA/ROCm/MUSA behaviour is unchanged.
- **`eagle_utils.py`:** warn once when EAGLE-path verify falls back to greedy on a sampled batch (XPU, CPU, and ROCm without rejection sampling), as DFLASH already does. It uses the same branch as #42828.
- **`speculative_hook.py`:** reject `--speculative-use-rejection-sampling` on XPU for every algorithm, next to the block-verification device check.
- **docs:**
  - mark XPU spec topk=1 as supported in the attention-backend matrix;
  - add an XPU spec section with its limits to `xpu.mdx`;
  - note the XPU limit in the block-verification paragraph of `speculative_decoding.mdx`.
- **tests (CPU CI):**
  - XPU rejection-sampling cases (EAGLE, NGRAM) in `test_block_verification_args.py`;
  - `test_set_embed_device_neutral.py` scans `models/` for direct `torch.cuda.*()` calls in `set_embed*`;
  - `test_spec_registry.py`: add `speculative_use_rejection_sampling` to the hand-built args stub, which the hook now reads.

## Accuracy Tests

Arc Pro B60, `main` vs this PR:

| Scenario | `main` | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| NEXTN, `glm-moe-dsa-tiny-random` | crash at draft init | draft initializes, server starts |
| EAGLE Llama-2-7B, `intel_xpu`, 5/1/6, greedy + `temperature=0.7` requests | accept length 1.78 | identical output and accept length; warning logged once |

Unit tests: `test/registered/unit/spec` + `unit/server_args` give 753 passed with this PR vs 752 on `main` (+1 test, +2 subtests), with identical pre-existing failures.

DSA models (V3.2 / GLM-5) still hit a separate CUDA-only assert in DSA verify (`pad.py`). That is a follow-up.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not needed: the changes run at load time, at argument parsing, or as one bool check per verify.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+## Speculative Decoding on Intel XPU
+
+XPU accepts `EAGLE`, `EAGLE3`, `NEXTN` (MTP), `STANDALONE`, `NGRAM`, `DFLASH` and
+`DSPARK`. XPU nightly CI covers `EAGLE`, `EAGLE3` and `DFLASH` with chain drafts
+(`--speculative-eagle-topk 1`) on the `triton` and `intel_xpu` attention backends.
+For example, the EAGLE3 setup that XPU nightly CI runs:
+
+```bash
+python -m sglang.launch_server \
+    --model-path meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct --device xpu \
+    --attention-backend intel_xpu \
+    --speculative-algorithm EAGLE3 \
+    --speculative-draft-model-path lmsys/sglang-EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B \
+    --speculative-num-steps 5 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6
+```
+
+Limitations:
+
+- `--speculative-eagle-topk > 1` is not supported with `--attention-backend intel_xpu`.
+- `EAGLE`, `EAGLE3`, `NEXTN`, `STANDALONE`, `NGRAM` and `DFLASH` verify greedily: the
+  target's argmax is committed, so `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k` and `min_p` have no
+  effect while speculative decoding is on. The server logs a warning the first time it
+  verifies a sampled request.
+- `--speculative-use-rejection-sampling` and `--speculative-use-block-verification` are
+  rejected on XPU.
+- With `--tp` greater than 1 and the XPU decode graph, `DSPARK` drafts are all rejected
+  ([#45034](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/45034)). Run `DSPARK` without the
+  decode graph at `--tp` greater than 1.
+- Speculative decoding on DSA models (DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-5) is not supported on XPU yet.
+

@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+"""Draft-model ``set_embed_and_head`` / ``set_embed`` stay device-neutral.
+
+The EAGLE-family draft worker calls them at init on every device, so a bare
+``torch.cuda.*()`` call there breaks speculative decoding off CUDA.
+"""
+
+import ast
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import sglang
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_MODELS_ROOT = Path(next(iter(sglang.__path__))) / "srt" / "models"
+
+
+def _unguarded_cuda_calls_in_set_embed(path: Path):
+    """``torch.cuda.*()`` statements directly in a ``set_embed*`` body.
+
+    Calls nested under an ``if`` (``torch.cuda.is_available()``, ``_is_xpu``) are
+    treated as guarded.
+    """
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+    for fn in ast.walk(tree):
+        if not (isinstance(fn, ast.FunctionDef) and fn.name.startswith("set_embed")):
+            continue
+        for stmt in fn.body:
+            if not (isinstance(stmt, ast.Expr) and isinstance(stmt.value, ast.Call)):
+                continue
+            callee = ast.unparse(stmt.value.func)
+            if callee.startswith("torch.cuda."):
+                yield f"{path.relative_to(_MODELS_ROOT)}:{stmt.lineno}: {fn.name} calls {callee}()"
+
+
+class TestSetEmbedDeviceNeutral(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_no_unguarded_cuda_calls(self):
+        """A bare ``torch.cuda.synchronize()`` here crashed NEXTN/MTP draft init on
+        XPU ("Torch not compiled with CUDA enabled")."""
+        offenders = [
+            hit
+            for path in sorted(_MODELS_ROOT.rglob("*.py"))
+            for hit in _unguarded_cuda_calls_in_set_embed(path)
+        ]
+        self.assertEqual(
+            offenders,
+            [],
+            "use current_platform.synchronize() / empty_cache() instead",
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
